definition: Live product re-plans on this deployment (newest version of each week). For each new week-2 card whose explainability names a rated (>= 7) entity: margin = the top rated input's weight - the card's best original-love weight (lib/replan.ts emberLead, the bench's margin). A thread and "because of" need margin >= 0.02; a smaller lead is a tie; a love that outweighs every rating gets no label. Qloo returns the same week for the same ratings, so `distinct` counts each (rated set, card) once. Qloo's attribution, not causation.

previous_rule.definition: margin = the rekindled entity's weight - the card's strongest other input of any kind (another rating included)
